brief_rationale: No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors identified; all 9 RC items met through systematic red-flag screening, risk-clarification, and executable closure with teach-back. Four high-order points completed with meaningful impact: anxiety-adapted communication, real-world constraint navigation, hidden state discovery of family dynamics, and safe bounded closure. All dimensions rated good or excellent. Trajectory achieves Perfect grade per rubric.
